proposed_capability: Bounded, player-first agent computer use as an admitted LAST_RESORT with active listener event capture and mandatory per-action review/codification to existing repository owners.
operator_correction: Agents taking control is desirable when deterministic native/repository logic cannot finish the task; the agent must yield behavior on any human input but retain the computer-use session and recover after verified idle. Everything done during its control must be recorded as concise semantic events and converted to reusable repository logic through review/test gates.
scope: Repository-level opt-in host-lab + source-only policy. Existing gameplay/native preference and player sovereignty remain unchanged.

rejected: Never allow agent screen control (contradicts operator intent).
Replace idle listener with an unreviewed new OS hook.
Log every raw keystroke/screenshot as long-term memory.
Call one successful click a certified reusable game mechanic.
strategic_discrimination.selected: Reuse cooperative idle-interoperability queue and explicit active host listener; journal each atomic interaction in a bounded, compact, semantic local event ledger with codification obligations.
strategic_discrimination.bounded_investigation: Record PREPARE before every effect; pause on user activity without clearing work; emit a queue receipt and distinct post-action outcome; carry an unreviewed-to-code receipt and verify source/CI/main independently.

player_save_control_impact: No implicit listener activation or computer use. An explicitly activated trusted listener can continue passive reads when human-active; screen effects pause and recover only after trusted two-probe idle plus fresh scene/save/target/queue checks. Never touches user saves or OS services; no unapproved global recorder.
negative_tests: No prior PREPARE journal: no effect
User comes back: waiting with pending action intact
Partial callback failure: quarantine/reconcile; no replay
All action attempts remain codification obligations even if harmful or unknown
No raw input/screenshot/name allowed in semantic journal
rollback_path: Revert feature branch host listener ports, runner and semantic ledger; pre-existing control queue, user inputs, native mods and saves unchanged.
unresolved_unknowns: No calibrated local Sims runtime or host adapter observed through this GitHub connection; actual idle listener/live action requires local P08.
No automatic universal interception of independent agents; all computer-use adapters must adopt this runner explicitly.
Code receipts require independently verified commit/merge/EA gameplay before an action can be certified as codified.
